title: Neon Blossom
description: Render a 6-petaled magenta (1.0, 0.0, 1.0) flower pattern using polar coordinates. The shape is defined by the distance from center r and the angle a.
hintText: Convert your UVs to polar coordinates using length() for radius and atan(y, x) for angle. Try using a cosine function on the angle to modulate the radius of the shape.
